dedupe_keys.name: jpcert cc quarterly incident response reports and tsubame internet threat monitoring

description: JPCERT/CC, Japan's national computer security incident response coordination centre, publishes a quarterly report on the incidents reported to it and its handling of them, including counts of incident reports and incidents by category such as phishing sites, website defacement, malware sites, scans and targeted attacks, together with its other activities; English editions follow the Japanese ones, and the report for April to June 2026 (3.6 MB PDF) was released on 21 August 2026. JPCERT/CC also runs TSUBAME, an internet threat monitoring system of sensors in Japan and the Asia-Pacific region that observes scanning and other unsolicited packets, and posts quarterly 'TSUBAME Report Overflow' notes on its blog with observations by port and source region. Coverage: incidents reported to JPCERT/CC from Japan and abroad; TSUBAME sensors in the Asia-Pacific. Format and access: PDF quarterly reports and blog posts, free. Caveats: counts reflect what is reported, and categories are JPCERT/CC's own; the incident categories listed are from recall. Simulation uses: frequency and type of cyber incidents for threat scenarios affecting digital infrastructure, and scan activity trends for exposure analysis. Related records: the NICTER darknet observation gives a larger scan view for Japan, and HKCERT and CERT.br publish comparable statistics.
